templates.html:
<footer class="cardfooter" style="--c:{{color}};">
  {{#if showSecondary}}<button type="button" class="cardfooter__secondary">{{secondaryLabel}}</button>{{/if}}
  <button type="button" class="cardfooter__primary">{{primaryLabel}}</button>
</footer>
<style>
.cardfooter { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; font: 13px system-ui, sans-serif; border-top: 1px solid #24143018; padding-top: 12px; }
.cardfooter__primary { border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: var(--c); color: #241430; }
.cardfooter__secondary { border: 1.5px solid #24143022; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #241430; }
.cardfooter__primary:focus-visible, .cardfooter__secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c); outline-offset: 2px; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<footer class="cardfooter-tw flex justify-end gap-2 font-sans text-[13px] border-t border-[#24143018] pt-3" style="--c:{{color}};">
  {{#if showSecondary}}<button type="button" class="border-[1.5px] border-[#24143022] rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 font-semibold cursor-pointer bg-transparent text-[#241430]">{{secondaryLabel}}</button>{{/if}}
  <button type="button" class="border-none rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 font-semibold cursor-pointer text-[#241430]" style="background:var(--c);">{{primaryLabel}}</button>
</footer>
